stories.headline: Russian strikes on Kyiv kill one, damage Dutch and Austrian embassies
stories.headlineEn: Russian strikes on Kyiv kill one, damage Dutch and Austrian embassies
stories.summaryEn: A wave of daytime Russian strikes on Kyiv on Thursday killed one person and damaged a historic cathedral as well as the embassies of Austria and the Netherlands. Loud explosions erupted across the Ukraine capital throughout the day as the leaders of Russia, China and the United States held a historic meeting in China that put Russia's President Vladimir Putin in international spotlight. FRANCE…

sources.title: Dutch and Austrian Embassies Are Damaged as Russian Drones Swarm Kyiv
Russian strikes on Kyiv kill one, damage Dutch and Austrian embassies
France seeks UN Security Council meeting after Russian strikes hit European embassies in Kyiv

stories.narrEn: France 24 reports: A wave of daytime Russian strikes on Kyiv on Thursday killed one person and damaged a historic cathedral as well as the embassies of Austria and the Netherlands. The New York Times reports: Foreign ministers for Austria and the Netherlands said no one was harmed at their embassy compounds, and the European Union’s ambassador said a drone “exploded right above my head" by her hotel. France 24 reports: France called for a UN Security Council meeting following a salvo of Russian strikes on Ukraine Friday that damaged the Austrian and Dutch embassies in Kyiv, Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said.
